RemediationKind.description:
How a patch tries to clear an incident.

Not every fault has a transform. Nulls stay null, and a late partition needs
a rerun. The fix step is allowed to refuse a code repair.

description:
A code change proposed for one hypothesis.

``id`` is the value later verdicts, verification, and approval must match.
``diff`` adds ``remediations/<incident_id>.py``. The regression test is pandera-based.
